data.body: Ruling-update fix landed: Gerrit change 2021 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2021), merged as 1ef5bc720b with LLM-Review +1 (clean, no findings on both patchsets) and Verified +1 (CI SUCCESS run 32528735556). Patchset 2 fixed a CI failure patchset 1 introduced: an unscoped caplog.set_level(DEBUG) raised the ROOT logger and let unrelated exc_info DEBUG records pollute the strict GH013 capsys assertion in full-suite order — now scoped to rebar._store.push_classify. Expected-case push outcomes (contention loss, mid-retry transport, static backlog) now emit NOTHING at INFO or above; policy declines, strict raises, and proven-growing backlog stay WARNING/raise; marker/fsck unchanged. Closed as plan_defect.
